exposure: absence of premature rupture of membranes > 18 hours
cohort: 440 infants born at ≥34 weeks' gestation at the Ottawa Hospital in November 2020
finding: Hypothermia within 6 hours of delivery was significantly associated with prematurity, low 5 minute Apgar score, need for resuscitation, maternal hypertension, and absence of premature rupture of membranes > 18 hours or suspected maternal infection.
